main_text.p: Παραδειγματίζω ignominiae expono.Fut. ισω.P. παραδειγματίσω, Matth.1.19.

Παράδεισος ἡ ὁ paradisus.Duo significat.1.proprie pomarium, viridarium. (vox origine Hebraa פַּרְדֵּס pardes Eccl.2.5.hortus amoenissimus, omnis generis fructiferis arboribus confitus. Errant, qui ex παράδ& δένδρω irrigo, vocem hanc ortam esse volunt.) 2.coelum tertium, locum beatorum 2.Cor.12.4.
Παραδέχομαι excipio, recipio. Fut. παραδέξομαι suscipiam.P. παραδέξομαι.

Παραδιατρίβη ης η perversa exercitatio. ex παρά, quod saepe in malam partem accipitur in compositis, & Διατριβὴ ης η opera, qua alicui rei impenditur, a Διατρίβω vide supra. Διατριβὴ μάταια, quum frustra tempus teritur.

Παραδίδωμι trado. imperf. παρεδίδων tanquam a παραδίδω. Fut. παραδώσω prodam. part. fut.1.act. παραδώσων Joh.6.64. a.1. παρέδωκα, a.2. παρέδων ως ω. a.2.subj. παραδῶ ὡς ᾧ. aor.2.infin. παραδοῦναι. part.aor.2. παραδοὺς ὄντος ὁ qui prodidit. prat.act. παραδεδωκὼς. plusq.perf. παραδεδώκειν εις ει Marc.15.10. pro παρεδεδώκειν. Attice ε abjicitur. praes. pass. παραδίδομαι prodor. prat.pass. παραδέδομαι traditus sum, commendatus sum. Act. 14.26. aor.1.pass. παρεδόθην ης η. fut.1.pass. παραδοθήσομαι tradar.

page.notes: The right-hand printed page is mostly cut off and illegible; its small margin notes were not transcribed. Greek passages are transcribed approximately from the scan; several accents and diacritics are uncertain, and the Hebrew word is reproduced as best read. Text at the bottom ("Παρα-") is a catchword.
